dark_wood_bend.idea: A rectangle whose north-west is one big cliff, leaving an L-shaped run with a web-choked hollow at the corner. Neither side can see round the bend until it's too late: an ambush map.

dark_wood_surround.idea: The party starts in the middle of a broken ring, a giant and spiders on every side. Four gaps to hold and no back line.

dark_wood_thorns.idea: Bramble masses and dead trees scattered wide, joined into broken walls. A winding walk for melee; ranged may shoot across if brambles don't stop sight.

deep_forest_gorge.idea: A long gorge under a cliff, closed twice by fallen trunks that each leave a one-cell gap. A running fight from gap to gap.

deep_forest_groves.idea: Wide ground with groves dotted over it, a big boulder and a rise of raised rock in the west with one stair up. No front line: lanes run between the groves and anyone can be flanked.

deep_forest_pocket.idea: A tight pocket ringed by pines, a trunk and a stump in the middle. Everyone is in reach almost at once; only the obstacles buy a turn.

fey_wood_crescent.idea: A narrow crescent round a stand of trees, on a small hex. Enemies at one tip, party at the other, and the way across is hidden until you round it.

fey_wood_glades.idea: Two glades split by a big grove, with a neck two cells wide below it. Whoever holds the neck holds the fight; giant mushrooms crowd each glade.

fey_wood_stones.idea: A ring of standing stones round a fairy ring. Each stone is one cell to step behind; what the ring itself does is a rule still to make.

heartwood_great_tree.idea: A huge tree fills the middle, so nobody can come straight at you; the fight goes round it both ways, over its roots and between lesser trees. A rise of raised rock with an earth ramp stands by the party.

heartwood_hollow.idea: A big oval pinched in the middle by a cliff from the west and trees from the east, with arching roots as low walls. The cliff's shelter is the prize: back to it, only two sides to watch.

heartwood_shelf.idea: A ridge of raised rock crosses the map's middle, cut by two gaps, with steps and ramps up from both sides. Hold the gaps, or take the top: each side picks what to force.
